facts.text: In 1930, Wiley made history by participating in the first interracial debate held in the American South.

sources.title: The Melvin B. Tolson & Denzel Washington Forensics Society
sources.quote: In 1930, Wiley made history by participating in the first interracial debate in the South, breaking barriers in higher education and competitive speech.

facts.text: The film The Great Debaters dramatizes Wiley's historic 1935 debate victory over the University of Southern California.

sources.title: The Melvin B. Tolson & Denzel Washington Forensics Society
sources.quote: The film highlights the 1935 debate victory over the University of Southern California, showcasing the power of argumentation and intellectual courage.
